note: Round four: the guardrail cases on the version 3 filter. Version 3 was written to fix the misses in the round-three test set, so these results are not evidence that it generalises: use python3 heldout.py v1 v2 v3 for that. Expected results are guesses written before the first run. Commit this file, then run: python3 run.py --round 4 --detector v3
